notes:
Summary: LocaleBridge builds a regional contact center layer for EMEA/APAC customers. Primary need is a multilingual agent-assist + ticket-summarization stack that preserves locale tone and supports automatic translation for CSAT-sensitive replies. They also require fine-grained regional routing (EU traffic to EU hosts), and tool-calling connectors to Zendesk + internal CRM.

POC highlights:
- Translation quality: FR/DE/ES acceptable at top-1, but nuance/tone needs instruction-tuning; SE recommended custom prompt templates + few-shot examples.
- Cost: combining streaming agent-assist + on-the-fly translation increased tokens by ~30%; Optimize recommendations could save ~12-20%.
- Reliability: spike run showed hosted API hit p95 ~310ms under default config; dedicated/quantized model met client SLOs.

Security/Compliance: GDPR + data residency are hard requirements; want VPC/private control plane option. Legal asked for retention controls and support for customer-managed KMS.

Quotes: "Tone matters — translations must read like a local CS agent, not a literal machine translation." — Head of Support (call 2026-01-14).

Next actions: finalize Dedicated sizing, share SOW draft, produce SOC2/ISO pack, run one more 4k-concurrent spike with caching enabled.
